title: Partial Hasse invariants for genus zero curves in Hilbert modular varieties
summary: We construct characteristic-zero lifts of partial Hasse invariants for genus zero non-compact curves in Hilbert modular varieties. The construction is based on recent results on the associated Picard-Fuchs differential equations. As an application, we relate the size of the non-ordinary locus of the modulo $p$ reduction of these curves to the dimension of spaces of (twisted) modular forms. We compute it explicitly for several Teichmüller curves, obtaining Deuring-like formulae.
